SEARCH
Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.search

Class SearchHandle

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.search.SearchHandle
public final class SearchHandle extends Object
The live control object returned by SearchEngine.search(org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.search.SearchQuery, java.util.function.Consumer<org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.search.SearchMatch>). It lets a caller stop a running walk, poll whether it has finished, block until it does, and read how many matches were emitted so far.

Thread-safe: the flags are atomic and completion is a CountDownLatch, so the EDT can cancel while worker threads are mid-walk and be told, exactly once, when the last worker has wound down.
